title: GNFactor: Multi-Task Real Robot Learning with Generalizable Neural Feature Fields
layout_note: Input -> voxel encoder -> one central 3-D volume, which branches down-front into a renderer (RGB and diffusion-feature images) and right into patch tokens and a Perceiver that also takes a language encoder from above and robot state from below.
grouping: No frames or panels; the branches are grouped by colour family - orange for the voxel and rendering path, blue for the policy path, green for language - and by position around the central volume.
shapes_depth: Networks are flat trapezoids (orange voxel encoder, green language encoder with a snowflake, blue Perceiver narrowing to the right); the volume is a 3-D cube with orange-tinted top layers over a white wireframe lattice, sampled by thin blue rays ending in circles with pulled-out blue cubes; the renderer is an extruded orange 3-D block cutting into the volume's front; tokens are small 3-D cubes in a column grading from orange to blue; rendered outputs are two tilted image tiles with orange borders.
proposed_highlight: The shared 'Deep 3D Volume' is the only large 3-D object, at the centre under a bold title; the renderer branch is drawn in the same orange as the encoder and volume; no legend.
lesson: Draw the shared representation as one central 3-D volume and let its two consumers leave it on different sides - a renderer below producing images, a patchify arrow to the right into the policy - each in its branch colour.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF footer 'Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2023), Atlanta, USA.'. Q-value outputs (Q_trans, Q_rot, Q_collide, Q_open) are listed as symbols at the right edge.

arrangement.units: no enclosed regions; one central volume with an encoder chain on its left, a renderer block on its lower front and a token-and-Perceiver chain on its right
arrangement.inputs_as: a real RGB front-view photo stacked above its depth point cloud; a quoted instruction enters from the top
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn: the renderer's RGB and diffusion-feature images sit below the volume with no target beside them, and the Q-value symbols end the policy branch at the right edge
arrangement.shared: the volume is drawn once in the middle; the renderer block cuts into its lower front and the patchify arrow leaves its right side

taxonomy.task: multi-task language-conditioned manipulation with a voxel feature volume shared by a neural-rendering branch and a Perceiver action branch

core.what: one Deep 3D Volume at the centre feeds two branches - a renderer cut into its lower front producing RGB and diffusion-feature images, and a patchify arrow from its right side into the Perceiver

relations.form: the volume drawn once as the central 3-D cube, the renderer attached below-front and the token chain leaving its right face
photo and point cloud -> 'Voxelize' -> voxel encoder -> volume on one horizontal line of orange arrows
patch tokens from the left, the language encoder from above and robot state from below converge on the Perceiver with blue arrows
rendering drawn on the volume itself: thin blue rays with circles sample cells of its wireframe lattice and pull out blue cubes

channels.colour: branch: orange = voxel and rendering path, blue = policy path, green = language; blue carries a second meaning as the render rays and sampled cells inside the volume, and the token column grades from orange to blue
channels.shape: trapezoid = network, large cube = feature volume, small cubes = tokens, tilted tiles = rendered images
channels.line: thick solid arrows coloured by branch; thin blue rays ending in circles = rendering samples
channels.frame: no frames; orange borders mark the renderer's output tiles

quality.strengths: The shared representation is the biggest, central object with both consumers attached on two sides, so 'shared' is geometry. The input is a real photo and its point cloud, and the rendered outputs are drawn as images. Arrows are short, straight and coloured by branch.
quality.weaknesses: Blue marks both the policy branch and the render rays and sampled voxels. The reconstruction objective is not drawn: the rendered RGB and diffusion feature have no target or loss beside them. The renderer block overlaps the volume's lattice and hides its front cells.

insights.structure: A central 3-D volume with the encoder chain to its left, a renderer block cut into its lower front and the token-to-Perceiver chain to its right; language enters from the top right.
insights.data: The input is a real RGB photo above its point cloud, the instruction is quoted, tokens are a column of small cubes and the renderer's outputs are two tilted images (RGB, diffusion feature).
insights.emphasis: The 'Deep 3D Volume' is the only large 3-D object and carries a bold title; the frozen language encoder is marked with a snowflake.
insights.flow: Orange arrows run left to right into the volume and out via 'Patchify'; blue arrows converge on the Perceiver and continue right to the Q-value symbols; the renderer branch drops below the volume.
insights.avoid: Do not reuse a branch colour for something inside the shared volume, and draw the reconstruction target next to the rendered outputs.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
